records.title: Automated Optimization Modeling via a Localizable Error-Driven Perspective
records.reason: The arXiv abstract presents MIND and DFPO as domain-specific post-training and training-data refinement for optimization modeling; it does not describe inference, serving, or runtime efficiency.

records.title: X-Talk: On the Underestimated Potential of Modular Speech-to-Speech Dialogue System
records.reason: The primary abstract describes an optimized cascaded LLM-driven speech pipeline that reaches sub-second latency, a concrete latency result for an inference-time dialogue system.

records.title: When Refusals Fail: Unstable Safety Mechanisms in Long-Context LLM Agents
records.reason: The primary abstract evaluates long-context agent capability and refusal stability, reporting safety and accuracy degradation rather than an efficiency method.

records.title: MARS-SQL: A multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for Text-to-SQL
records.reason: MARS-SQL trains role-specialized agents with interactive RL and trajectory ranking to improve SQL accuracy; the abstract gives no serving-cost or latency reduction.

records.title: Entropy-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Adaptive Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
records.reason: The current arXiv title and abstract describe CurioSFT for preserving exploration during SFT; this is a post-training objective and reports reasoning quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Gained in Translation: Privileged Pairwise Judges Enhance Multilingual Reasoning
records.reason: SP3F uses translation-based SFT and privileged-judge RL to improve multilingual reasoning accuracy; it is a training recipe without an inference/runtime optimization.

records.title: PASs-MoE: Mitigating Misaligned Co-drift among Router and Experts via Pathway Activation Subspaces for Continual Learning
records.reason: PAS-guided router reweighting and rank stabilization reduce continual-tuning forgetting at fixed model capacity; the abstract does not show lower inference cost or latency.

records.title: Optimizing User Profiles via Contextual Bandits for Retrieval-Augmented LLM Personalization
records.reason: PURPLE uses a contextual bandit to order user-profile memories for RAG and reports effectiveness and efficiency, but the abstract does not specify a concrete reduction in prompt tokens, serving cost, or latency.

records.title: Evidence-Augmented Policy Optimization with Reward Co-Evolution for Long-Context Reasoning
records.reason: EAPO changes reward supervision and reward-policy co-evolution during RL to improve evidence quality in long-context reasoning; it reports no execution-efficiency result.

records.title: KASER: Knowledge-Aligned Student Error Simulator for Open-Ended Coding Tasks
records.reason: KASER is an RL-trained simulator for student coding errors and evaluates prediction diversity and coverage, not LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Discovering and Causally Validating Emotion-Sensitive Neurons in Large Audio-Language Models
records.reason: This study identifies and validates emotion-sensitive neurons in audio-language models; its interpretability and causal-analysis contribution is not a system-efficiency method.

records.title: Musical Score Understanding Benchmark: Evaluating Large Language Models' Comprehension of Complete Musical Scores
records.reason: MSU-Bench evaluates musical-score understanding by language and vision-language models; the contribution is an application benchmark rather than an efficiency benchmark.

records.title: On the Entropy Calibration of Language Models
records.reason: The paper studies calibration of generation entropy and output diversity; its proposed distribution truncation discussion concerns generation quality, not runtime cost.

records.title: AV-Dialog: Spoken Dialogue Models with Audio-Visual Input
records.reason: AV-Dialog improves speaker tracking, transcription, and turn-taking in noisy audio-visual dialogue; the abstract reports task robustness but no LLM-serving efficiency or latency measurement.

records.title: WebShaper: Agentically Data Synthesizing via Information-Seeking Formalization
records.reason: WebShaper synthesizes training data for information-seeking agents; its contribution is data generation and agent training, not inference execution efficiency.

records.title: Jailbreaking LLM-Controlled Robots
records.reason: This paper studies jailbreak attacks on LLM-controlled robots, a robotics safety application with no stated model-inference or serving-efficiency contribution.

records.title: CellPLM: Pre-training of Cell Language Model Beyond Single Cells
records.reason: Stable DOI and supplied bibliographic title identify CellPLM, but the primary bioRxiv abstract could not be read: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2023.10.03.560734v1 returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, and https://doi.org/10.1101/2023.10.03.560734 was inaccessible through the browser tool. Abstract/body were not read; no secondary abstract was used.

records.title: Reversing the Forget-Retain Objectives: An Efficient LLM Unlearning Framework from Logit Difference
records.reason: ULD reports more than threefold faster LLM unlearning training, but the improvement is confined to training time and does not address inference or serving.

records.title: Towards Learning Universal Hyperparameter Optimizers with Transformers
records.reason: OptFormer meta-learns general hyperparameter optimization from tuning histories; its optimization target is experiment selection, not LLM inference, serving, or runtime.

records.title: Handcrafted Backdoors in Deep Neural Networks
records.reason: This paper addresses handcrafted backdoors in deep neural networks, a security topic rather than LLM inference, serving, runtime, or model efficiency.
